response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_inst FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_inst) AS baseline FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_inst) AS mean_of_averages, AVG(g.avg_inst - b.baseline) AS mean_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_inst > b.baseline
